P U R I T Y · S T A N D A R D

Third-party verified.Published, on file.

The research-peptide industry has never had consistent third-party testing as a standard. Most vendors publish no Certificates of Analysis. Some publish claimed COAs without independent verification. We do the third thing — independent testing through a third-party laboratory, with the Certificate of Analysis published alongside the product.

Side by side

Industry standard vs vialchemlabs standard for COA testing
StandardIndustry typicalvialchemlabs
COA publicationMost vendors publish no Certificates of Analysis (only ≈11% of the 1,500-vendor universe publishes independent third-party COAs).Independent third-party lab testing with the COA published alongside the product. The data is on the table.
Identity & purityIn-house HPLC where reported, methodology often unstated, sometimes claimed without independent verification.Reverse-phase HPLC area-percent at 220nm through an independent third-party lab. Mass spectrometry available on request.
SterilityRarely reported on research-grade peptides.USP <71> broth-based growth assay (Fluid Thioglycollate + Soybean-Casein Digest). 14-day incubation. PASS/FAIL reporting.
EndotoxinAlmost never reported; when reported, often as a single threshold number with no methodology.Limulus Amebocyte Lysate gel-clot in EU/mg. Numeric concentration with assay sensitivity limit.
Batch traceabilityMixed; aggregated lot reports common; vial number sometimes does not resolve to a specific COA.The number on the vial resolves to a published COA, on the order confirmation, and through the lab’s portal.
Two-tier riskTested-vs-shipped batches sometimes diverge; no enforcement mechanism for buyers.No two-tier system. The COA is the receipt for the vial in hand.

From synthesis to ship

The pipeline from sample draw to your bench.

  1. 01

    Sourced

    Synthesized at GMP-licensed facility against the canonical sequence; release documents reviewed before warehouse intake.

  2. 02

    Sampled

    Sample drawn under chain-of-custody and shipped to an independent third-party laboratory for test.

  3. 03

    Tested

    HPLC area-percent purity, USP <71> sterility, LAL endotoxin in EU/mg. Mass spec available on request.

  4. 04

    Published

    COA posted to /coa with batch number, test date, and methodology so the data is on file.

  5. 05

    Lyophilized & vialed

    Pharmaceutical-grade lyophilization, vialed and labeled with batch number that resolves to the published COA.

  6. 06

    Shipped

    Same-business-day on US orders before 3pm Mon-Fri via USPS Priority or FedEx 2-Day, tracked end-to-end.
